messages:
Sophie: Quick heads-up — partners pushed tentative firmware windows for H100/H200 and MI300. Can we do a short cadence sync later today to map marketplace announcement lanes? :calendar:
Devon: yep, what time works? I have SI calls at 10:30 and 15:00 PT.
Lina: I can take an early slot. We should include the SI integrator leads (cc @Raj) and the cloud marketplace PMs.
Raj: added. main ask: do we gate our GA announcement on their certified images, or do we run a soft-GA with a compatibility matrix?
Sophie: thinking soft-GA for H200/B200 variants, hard GA for H100/MI300 when images are certified. Need an embargo plan for press + partner comms.
Devon: Agreed. Also need a fallback model routing policy if an instance type flaps — we can route traffic to equivalent SKUs in Dedicated for 24h.
Lina: Ops note: lab can certify Gaudi in ~3 weeks if vendor provides the new kernel. MI300 is still pending microcode from vendor.
HW-Bot: [build-status] gaudi-lab-image: queued -> expected 2024-06-10 per vendor ETA.
Sophie: Can someone draft a short decision table? Minimal cols: Vendor, SKU, Cert ETA, Announcement lane, Comm owner, Fallback. I can take comms cells.
Raj: I'll own the fallback routing policy and write the routing playbook snippet. Devon can own marketplace tagging and SKU mapping.
Devon: on it — will create draft tags: "redwood:hw:mi300-ga" and fallback tags for SKUs.
Lina: schedule proposal: 9:00 PT sync tomorrow with SI + marketplace PMs. If that works I'll send calendar + agenda.
Sophie: 9:00 PT works for me. Agenda bullet 1: Cert status + blockers; 2: Announce lanes & embargo windows; 3: Fallback routing + Dedicated handoff; 4: SI partner readiness checklist.
Raj: FYI - we should also flag any firmware embargo constraints for legal before comms. I'll ping Legal once we have concrete ETAs.
Devon: drafting the SKU mapping now, will post in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
Sophie: thanks — please post drafts in #partnerships and drop a copy to marketplace PMs. I'll prep press ops note after sync.
Lina: invite sent to SI leads + marketplace PMs + Legal. Calendar includes short pre-read.
Sophie: perfect. If anything changes re: vendor ETAs, update this thread so we can rerun the embargo window calc.
